name: BTA06
description: A 6A triac in TO-220AB. ST labels the main terminals A1/A2 (A1 = MT1, A2 = MT2). The BTA variant has a voltage-insulated tab; the BTB variant has a non-insulated tab. Logic-level and snubberless (W-suffix) versions are 3-quadrant.

pins.name: A2
pins.description: main terminal 2 (MT2); tied to the tab

TO-220AB.notes: front face toward you, leads down: pin 1 (A1), pin 2 (A2/tab), pin 3 (G) left to right. BTA tab is insulated (2500Vrms) but still electrically A2; BTB tab is non-insulated.

typical_application: AC on/off and phase control: static relays, heater regulation, dimmers, motor speed. W-suffix snubberless parts suit inductive loads.
gotchas: the tab is A2 (MT2). BTA = insulated tab (no mica needed); BTB = non-insulated, needs isolation hardware
logic-level and snubberless (W-suffix) variants are 3-quadrant only; they cannot trigger in Q4 (MT2-, gate+)
ST uses A1/A2 instead of MT1/MT2; A1 is the gate-reference terminal
